intro: ChartForgeX ships features first; ImagePlayground exposes them as commands. Each row was checked against ImagePlayground 3.2.7, so scripts can rely on what is marked available today. Partial rows work with the limits noted, often through -ChartScript, which hands a script the ChartForgeX chart and its full .NET API.

tracking.title: Request a command or vote on the roadmap

rows.capability: Thirty chart kinds as commands: line, area, stacked and step area, bar, horizontal bar, scatter, bubble, lollipop, range, box plot, histogram, heatmap, pie, donut, radial, gauge, progress, pictorial, bullet, funnel, treemap, waterfall, radar, polar, slope and word cloud
Legend, data labels, palette, grid, axis titles, transparent backgrounds and donut centre text
Reference lines and point callouts
Chart titles and category labels
rows.note: 3.2.7 has no -Title or category-label parameter. Set them on the chart from -ChartScript or -PassThru, as two examples above do. -Title and -Subtitle are already in the ImagePlayground source for the next release.

rows.capability: Sankey, sunburst, chord, Gantt, timeline, candlestick and calendar heatmap
rows.note: No dedicated commands yet. The ChartForgeX methods (AddSankey, AddSunburst, AddGanttTask and others) are reachable from -ChartScript.

rows.capability: Dotted, region and tile maps
rows.note: Reachable from -ChartScript with AddDottedMap, AddRegionMap and AddTileMap; no map commands yet.

rows.capability: Bar and line combinations in one chart
rows.note: New-ImageChart rejects definitions of different kinds, and all lines must share one marker setting. ChartForgeX has AddBarLineCombo and related combos.

rows.capability: Graphite design tokens and brand kits
rows.note: -Theme offers fourteen named themes. The Graphite tokens and brand kits that chartforgex.com uses need the .NET API.

rows.capability: Service maps with kinds, statuses, groups, ports, node details and edge labels
Manual, grouped, hub, force-directed, radial, mind-map and geographic layouts
Automatic layered layout for branching graphs
rows.note: In 3.2.7, -Layout Layered packs graphs deeper than two levels into two columns. Use -Layout Manual with positions from data, as the service map above does.

rows.capability: Organization charts from manager links
Scenarios and route motion as animated SVG or GIF
Interactive HTML with pan, zoom and node details
Layout diagnostics and collision checks
Vendor icon packs (Azure, Fortinet, Veeam)
rows.note: Nodes accept -IconId, but no command loads a ChartForgeX icon pack yet.

rows.capability: Graph explorer for large graphs (Canvas and WebGL)
rows.note: Part of ChartForgeX.Interactivity.Html, not yet exposed.

rows.capability: Dashboards of metric cards, tables, lists, timelines and charts
Table blocks from pipeline objects
rows.note: 3.2.7 rejects [pscustomobject] rows with 'Row value count must match table column count'. Pass hashtables or arrays of values, as the dashboard above does.

rows.capability: Social preview cards and desktop wallpapers
Watermarks on charts, maps and exported artifacts
Visual artifacts with accessible names and descriptions
rows.note: Charts and topology convert; a visual grid is rejected in 3.2.7. Export grids with New-ImageVisualStory.

rows.capability: Animated terminal sessions as SVG, HTML, GIF or APNG
rows.note: A .png path writes the final frame; use .apng for animation.

rows.capability: Source-to-result stories with code and media panels
Motion cues on dashboards
PNG, SVG, JPEG and static HTML, chosen by file extension
Interactive chart HTML: tooltips, selection, zoom and brushing
rows.note: Chart HTML from 3.2.7 is static and script-free. Only topology has -InteractiveHtml.

rows.capability: Mermaid diagrams rendered by ChartForgeX.Mermaid
rows.note: ChartForgeX.Mermaid is not part of the module yet.

rows.capability: ChartForgeX Markup fences: charts and diagrams from Markdown
rows.note: ChartForgeX.Markup is not part of the module yet.
